annotations.title: Get the link that lists a game

description: Use when someone wants to list, submit or publish their browser game on Foundplay. For the game's play link, returns the foundplay.io link that lists it for free, with the submit form filled in from the game's page, and what happens next; if the game is already listed, its page instead. The person signs in with their email and publishes; some games need review. Read-only: nothing is listed until they publish. For plays and status, use check_game.

playUrl.description: Where people play the game, starting with https://.

name: get_listing_link

outputSchema.description: The free listing link for a game that isn't listed, or the page of one that is.

alreadyListed.description: Whether a game with this play link is live on Foundplay now.

canonicalUrl.description: The listed game's Foundplay page without tracking, to cite.

dropAt.description: The accepted drop time, as an ISO timestamp; only present while waiting for that drop.

freeWaysToGetPlayers.description: Free ways to get the first players.

listForFree.description: The link that opens Foundplay's submit form with this play link; the details are filled in from the game's page.

next.description: The next step, stated as a fact about where things stand.

status.description: The public listing state: live, waiting for its drop, hidden while its link is down, waiting for review, or taken down.
enum: hidden while its play link is down

takenDown.description: true when this game was taken down, rather than waiting for a drop or review.

whatHappens.description: What happens after the person opens the link.

title: Get the link that lists a game
